purpose: Executed public upstream observations for the future adotenv 0.3 dialect implementation, not a claim that Portable already conforms to these profiles.
platform: Linux; UTF-8 input; case-sensitive process environment

inputs.source: Fresh synthetic UTF-8 text in cases.json; CR, LF and BOM spelling is intentional.
inputs.environment: Complete controlled lookup/initial loading target; no ambient variables.
inputs.service_environment: Optional explicit Compose service environment map; null is YAML-equivalent bare/unset. Only the two service-role profiles use this field.

observation_policy: Every declared profile executes every case independently. Expectations are recorded only from successful adapter execution against pinned distributions/modules.

Literal parsing, interpolation/resolution, project environment preparation and application/service loading have separate named profiles. Compose default parsing always expands; no nonexistent interpolation-off option is claimed.
Final maps are not ordered declaration streams. Only Python Binding records and Docker raw KEY=VALUE lists retain upstream order. JSON null is distinct from an empty string and from an absent key.
Unsupported source items/spans/diagnostic identities are declared in profile metadata, not synthesized. Human warning/error prose and temporary file paths are excluded.
Adapter failures and missing profiles/cases fail the runner; they are never accepted as upstream parse results. Actual documented API exception/error surfaces are observed separately.
Runtime versions and execution time are recorded as provenance, not compared as semantic golden data. Dependency lock and API-profile hashes bind expected observations to their inputs.
No private corpus, local dotenv files, process credentials, shell evaluation, Docker daemon or container image is used by the runner. Core Cargo dependencies and MSRV are unaffected.

known_discrepancies.documentation: Service env_file reference describes a bare key as unset.
known_discrepancies.observed: Pinned Compose default and raw service loaders inherit A=external for source A followed by LF when project environment supplies A=external; unresolved bare entries do not delete prior assignments. Explicit YAML service_environment null is a separate role and can override file values with unset.
